hello.requested_device: UINT32_MAX or legacy request selects default device 0; otherwise create the initial session context on this ordinal
hello.state: First frame only; request flags must be zero; legacy 8-byte or 12-byte request; extended 16-byte request adds native context flags; invalid or duplicate HELLO closes the connection; native session context created only after valid complete HELLO

parameter_kinds.scalar: fixed-width integer or floating-point value in the payload
parameter_kinds.host_bytes: length-prefixed bytes copied into server staging memory
parameter_kinds.shape_stride_layout: rank plus fixed-width shape/stride arrays; never native pointers
parameter_kinds.transfer_completion: server-owned CNDrv notifier associated with the queued operation

generic_kernel.abi: LP64 little endian scalar bytes; metadata sizes must agree
generic_kernel.image: ELF64 LE CNFB v2 single image; max 64 MiB
generic_kernel.arguments: count then descriptors kind/size/allocation/offset/reserved and size bytes
generic_kernel.limits: 256 arguments; 4096 bytes each; null or owned allocation pointers only

module_get_kernel.limits: 1..255 symbol bytes; owned generic module only
module_get_kernel.lifetime: Stable per parent module/symbol; parent unload/reset invalidates all children; no cross-module image deduplication

transport.deadlines: Absolute CLOCK_MONOTONIC; short I/O and EINTR do not renew the deadline
transport.client: Connect: 5000ms after DNS across all candidate addresses; RPC: 120000ms total send+receive after context lock
transport.server: First HELLO receive: 5000ms; established frame receive including idle: 120000ms; each response send: 120000ms; native execution excluded
transport.configuration: MLU_REMOTE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS / RPC_TIMEOUT_MS / SERVER_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_MS / SERVER_IO_TIMEOUT_MS; decimal 1..3600000; captured on connect/startup
transport.timeout: Local status 0x80000006 MLU_REMOTE_TIMEOUT; close/poison; no reconnect/replay; server receive/send timeout closes connection
transport.identity: Process-global never-reused 64-bit sequence XOR kernel-random startup nonce; per-session owner/type/live validation; probabilistic cross-restart collision resistance
transport.not_bounded: DNS, mutex wait, parameter packing/allocation, native CNDrv/cleanup, worker drain

resource_lifecycle.quotas: Startup positive decimal SESSION/TOTAL_DEVICE_BYTES (1/8 GiB), STAGING_BYTES (64/256 MiB), IMAGE_BYTES (64/256 MiB), with MLU_REMOTE_ prefix; requested/reserved byte accounting, not physical/native-internal memory
resource_lifecycle.admission: MLU_REMOTE_MAX_CONNECTIONS default 32 range 1..1024; includes pre-HELLO and cleanup; excess sockets closed
resource_lifecycle.completion: MLU_REMOTE_SESSION_MAX_TRANSFERS default/range 1024/1..1024; includes completed unreleased objects; capacity checked before copy/launch submission
resource_lifecycle.error: 0x80000007 MLU_REMOTE_RESOURCE_LIMIT / REMOTE_RESOURCE_LIMIT; rejected before native submission; healthy session retained; CNRT maps to cnrtErrorNoMem
resource_lifecycle.shutdown: SIGINT/SIGTERM self-pipe stops accept, shutdowns tracked sockets and waits worker native cleanup; no native time bound; cleanup failures reported/nonzero exit; failed context destruction stops admission and quarantines retained buffers/charges until exit
resource_lifecycle.D2H: Queue wait before synchronous native copy; failed wait must not leave async writers targeting dispatcher response buffers

driver_context.module_load_binary: image_bytes/u32 + exact ELF/CNFB image; reply ModuleID/u64; no first kernel required
driver_context.context_sync: empty request/reply; actual cnCtxSync, completion releases H2D staging
driver_context.session_close: empty request/reply; native cleanup acknowledged, connection closed, context not recreated
